<SECTION-2 ACLASS="MANDATORY">
<TITLE ATOC="Y" AASSOCNOTE="D-0-3-6-0">6. Ÿ 繫  </TITLE>

<P>&cr;
<SPAN USERMARK="F-14 B">. 繫ǥ ۼ  ǻ&cr;</SPAN>
<SPAN> 2020 11 13  ̻ȸ ο Ͽ ڵǰι ӱ ھ()  Ÿ Ư ()̿ǿ  2,798鸸 ŰϿϴ.    ߴܿ ݿϿ 40() 繫ǥ   ۼϿ, 39() 繫ǥ   ۼϿϴ. ڼ  </SPAN>

<SPAN>III. 繫   - 5. 繫ǥ ּ - 31. ߴܿ</SPAN>
<SPAN> Ͻñ ٶϴ.</SPAN>

<P USERMARK="F-14 0XFF0000 B">
<SPAN USERMARK=" 0X000000">.  Ȳ</SPAN>

<P>
